AUTHOR: Connolly
TITLE: Estimating enhanced fish production on restored shellfish reefs using automated data collection from underwater videos
REGION: Port Phillip Bay (Victoria) and Gulf St Vincent (South Australia), Australia
SPECIES: Temperate reef/soft-sediment nekton incl. Chrysophrys auratus, Meuschenia scaber, Trachinops caudimaculatus, Arripis spp., Sepioteuthis australis (25 VIC, 12 SA classes)
DATA: Own 169 unbaited stereo-RUV deployments (GoPro Hero 9), 3 survey periods 2022-2023; 11,443 annotated frames
V_EV: Sec. 2.2: 'Water clarity measured as the distance fish can be seen from each camera deployment... Dromana 1.6 and 1.7 m, Maragaret 1.7 and 2.2 m, Glenelg 1.1 and 1.1 m'
D2: Per state: VIC 20,201/5,996/5,202 annotations train/eval/test; SA 5,821/1,835 annotations, test 994 images
D_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'Annotations from each state were further split into training, evaluation and testing data sets.' No grouping by video/deployment stated.
R_EV: Sec. 2.3: models retrained with each survey period's data and tested on held-out annotations of the same surveys: 'Testing data sets were used once for estimating detection model performance'
C_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'we selected an optimal inference confidence threshold for each species that balanced Precision and Recall' - no threshold values given in main text.
E_EV: Sec. 2.3/3: automated Mean Count converted to juvenile densities and sizes; 'Enhancement of fish production is estimated to be, on average, 6186 kg ha−1 year−1 (SD 1802)'
ARCH: YOLOv5 within FishID software; stereo sizing; Mean Count; growth/mortality biomass model
NOTE: PLAT: unbaited stereo RUV (no BRUV-specific option for RUV); ENV: subtidal restored oyster/limestone reefs plus adjacent soft sediment in temperate bays (coded 온대 암반/켈프; could be 혼합). D: split unit not stated; counts of annotations/images only, coded as image-level per rule. C: per-species thresholds chosen to balance P/R but values only possibly in Table S2 (not in text) -> C1 NR, C_ALL NR; rare-species detections manually curated but no FP rate. E: no comparison of automated counts with manual/independent counts; stereo size validated only on known-size objects (±10%). V3: sampling restricted to 09:00-14:00 daylight, not coded as illumination report. Dryad data likely derived counts, not imagery. Snapper accuracy 52% due to low recall discussed qualitatively.
